name: a context literal of 100,000 entries, each a context that holds the entry before
why: The candidate stops it with the value-depth error at 501 levels (docs/CONTRACT.md §2), where 0.5.0 exhausts its memory and traps. The request is 2 MB, too large to commit with a ledger entry; its 501-level form, the chain of context literals in requests/value-depth.json, is registered.

name: a context literal of 50,000 closures, each returning the closure before
why: The candidate stops it with the value-depth error at 501 levels (docs/CONTRACT.md §2), where 0.5.0 exhausts its memory and traps. The request is 1.3 MB, too large to commit with a ledger entry; its 501-level form, the chain of closures in requests/value-depth.json, is registered.
